events.title: FastAPI first released
events.summary: Sebastián Ramírez released FastAPI on December 5, 2018 — an async Python API framework with automatic OpenAPI docs.
events.about: FastAPI uses Python type hints and Pydantic for validation, Starlette for async I/O, and auto-generates Swagger UI docs. Used for ML inference APIs, microservices, and high-throughput backends. Example: `async def read_item(item_id: int)` with request/response schemas enforced at runtime and documented for free.

narrative.whyChosen: FastAPI became the default for new Python APIs when async and OpenAPI docs mattered.
narrative.whyImportant: It showed type hints could drive validation, serialization, and documentation in one cohesive framework.
narrative.problemSolved: Flask lacked native async and automatic API schemas; teams bolted on Marshmallow and manual Swagger.
